name: OpenStreetMap
description: Buildings, roads, parks, water, land surface, points of interest and features by tag from OpenStreetMap, loaded through Autark for a box or for named areas. Each row but the surface's is one OpenStreetMap node, way or relation, with its tags and its id; heights, widths, speeds and counts are numbers.

parameters.label: Area
parameters.description: A box, or the areas inside a place as OpenStreetMap names their boundaries.

resources.name: Buildings
resources.description: Buildings and building parts, one row each, named by osm_id. Footprints that touch share a building_id, as an Autark map draws them as one building. Sheds, garages, carports and other small structures are left out.

resources.name: Roads
resources.description: Streets, roads, tracks and paths, as lines, without footways, cycleways, steps or pedestrian streets.

resources.name: Parks
resources.description: Parks, playgrounds, woods, grass, cemeteries and other green space.

resources.name: Water
resources.description: Lakes, ponds, reservoirs, river areas and wetlands.

resources.name: Surface
resources.description: The land inside the area: the box, or the named areas' outline.

resources.name: Points of interest
resources.description: Places people visit: amenities, shops, tourism, leisure, offices, crafts, healthcare and historic sites, as points, lines and polygons.

resources.name: Features by tag
resources.description: The nodes, ways and multipolygons with any of the tags you enter, as points, lines and polygons.

parameters.label: Tags
parameters.description: Tags as key=value, such as amenity=school, or key=* for any value.

resources.name: All layers
resources.description: Buildings, roads, parks, water and surface, as one group of five datasets.
